en.titre:
10/10 hobbies that cost nothing
if you have adhd

colonne: you can grab five books on five topics, drop the boring ones and keep the one your brain _won't let go_
en.chute: a library card costs nothing, ask at the desk

en.accroche: the only gear you need is _a pair of shoes_
colonne: steady cardio gives a restless body somewhere to put its energy, and a first 5k gives a wandering mind a _finish line_
_pro tip_: i use atala, an ai running coach that plans my week around my goal
en.chute: start with 1 minute running, 1 minute walking

en.accroche: your brain loves a _route_ it's _never seen_
colonne: new corners, new shops, new sounds: novelty keeps your attention switched on without a _screen_
en.chute: pick a street you've never walked and turn left twice

colonne: the longer you look the more you find: the light, the hands, the tiny thing in the corner nobody _notices_
_pro tip_: i use artura, one artwork a day with its story, zooming into the details you'd miss
en.chute: most museums have a free day every month

en.accroche: every move is a _tiny puzzle_ you _can't skip_
colonne: the board changes every turn, so a brain that bores fast always has a _new problem_ to solve
en.chute: bring a board, someone always wants to play
